race.comment: GOODNESS (8) resumed with a good run at Sale when boxing into third, beaten 1.5 lengths. She'd shown ability in three runs last preparation and should strip fitter second up. Gets every chance from the gate and will take catching. ROYAL MAXIMUS (3) resumes having steadily improved in four runs last time in, beaten a long neck at Sale before the spell. Draws low for Lane and this looks a good kick-off point. DORCHESTER (9) is a filly by Almanzor who can run well on debut for the Hawkes yard, watch the betting. GUN CITY (6) resumes having run a fair race on debut. Suited to this trip first up and must respect the yard at home.
